title: Model-pin quality gate: tiered eval routing and rollback thresholds
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Problem: When a catalog or tenant pins a new model version we need to detect regressions quickly without blowing evaluation budgets or causing false alarms. Current ad-hoc preflight runs either miss tenant-specific regressions or run at too high a cost for frequent pin events.

Goal: Implement an orchestrated, tiered evaluation workflow that: (1) runs fast synthetic probes against the catalog-level pin, (2) escalates to sampled tenant shadow runs for customer-pinned upgrades when synthetic signals exceed thresholds, and (3) triggers automated rollback hooks when statistically-significant regressions are detected. The flow should be cost-aware, configurable per-tenant priority, and integrate with rollout policies (canary, A/B, immediate pin).
acceptance_criteria: A tiered eval orchestration is available: catalog-synthetic -> tenant-sampled escalation
Configurable thresholds (delta, p-value surrogate, and KPI-specific bounds) stored in the eval policy store
Automated rollback hook that can create a rollback job and notify the rollout controller when thresholds breached
Cost budget guard prevents tenant escalation if monthly eval quota would be exceeded
Owner-visible dashboard: per-pin eval summary, drift metrics, and confidence bands
Integration tests cover synthetic detection -> tenant escalation -> rollback sequence in the eval-orchestrator CI pipeline
implementation_notes: High-level plan: (1) Extend eval-orchestrator to accept pin events (catalog or tenant) and apply a policy lookup based on model family + tenant priority. (2) Schedule lightweight synthetic probes (50–200 synthetic queries) that exercise targeted prompt families and extract KPIs (accuracy, harmfulness, latency regression). (3) If synthetic signal exceeds threshold, sample live traffic shadowing for an expanded set (per-tenant sampling rate derived from priority). (4) Compute delta metrics with bootstrap confidence intervals and compare against rollback rules. (5) Emit action: NOOP / ALERT / ROLLBACK. Include operator override endpoints and manual 'hold' action. Use existing eval runner binaries with a "fast-probe" mode to minimize infra spin-up time.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Over-reacting to noisy synthetic probes causing unnecessary rollbacks. Mitigation: Use conservative thresholds, require cross-check with tenant-sampled shadow runs for rollback, and add an operator approval window for high-impact tenants. Risk: Cost blowout from frequent escalations. Mitigation: budget guard and per-tenant monthly eval caps with fallback to manual review. Risk: Latency in detection for low-traffic tenants. Mitigation: weighted sampling and priority-based sampling amplification for low-traffic customers.
decisions: Adopt tiered evaluation (synthetic -> tenant shadow) rather than full immediate fanout to control cost
Use simple nonparametric bootstrap intervals for delta confidence rather than complex hypothesis testing to keep compute light
Rollback action will create a rollback ticket + call rollout-controller API rather than directly reverting model binaries
work_items: Extend eval-orchestrator API to consume model.pin & model.promote events (ENG-42177)
Implement fast-probe runner and synthetic probe specs for common prompt families (ENG-53109)
Policy store: add per-model-family and per-tenant priority + thresholds configuration UI (Console)
Dashboard: pin-eval-summary with delta time series and action history
Create automated rollback adapter to call rollout-controller and create a notification in Slack/Console
